title: Baseline answers, version 0
description: A repository's own answers to the baseline: what the baseline cannot decide for it, and any exception it takes, each with a reason. Written as TOML, at `.athenaeum/baseline.toml`. Every key is listed here: an unknown key is an error, so a misspelt one fails instead of being ignored.

schema_version.description: The version of this schema the answers follow. A reader that does not know the version must refuse them.

licence.description: The licence the repository uses, as a lower-case slug that names a licence template.

contact.description: Where a vulnerability is reported: an address or a link.

required_checks.description: The checks the default branch requires, each named as GitHub reports it. At least one, with no name repeated.

default_branch_bypass.description: Who may bypass the default branch's rules. `admin-pull-request`: the repository administrator, and only by merging a pull request, never by pushing. `none`: nobody.

exceptions.description: Baseline items the repository does not satisfy, keyed by item id, each with the reason. Keying by id makes a repeated id impossible to write. That an id names a real item is checked by the tool that reads both this file and the baseline.

reason.description: Why the repository does not satisfy the item. Shown in every report that excepts it.
